## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `hubspot-crm-obj-deals-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a HubSpot developer app

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your [HubSpot Developer Portal](https://developers.hubspot.com/). -->
2. Select **Apps** in the top navigation.
3. Select **Create app**.
4. <!-- manual: Enter an App name (e.g., Ballerina Deals Integration) and optionally a description. -->
5. Select **Create app**.

## Step 6: Alternative: use a private app token

2. <!-- manual: Navigate to Integrations › Private Apps. -->
3. Select **Create a private app**.
4. <!-- manual: Give it a name, then under Scopes add crm.objects.deals.read and crm.objects.deals.write. -->
